scope: Engineering correctness: DRC/check normalization, ERC identity/waivers, manufacturing geometry/inventory oracle, release authority and journal recovery/integrity.
authority: Owner-requested audit and tracking only; no product modification, implementation grant, new normative mechanism, acceptance bar or milestone selection.
candidate_limits: Committed baseline is the audited candidate; active dirty product/prototype work is excluded from delivery judgments.
Source review/control-flow counterexamples plus specifically labeled Python transcriptions; no new compiled Rust, GUI, vendor-client or physical-board qualification.
Earlier CA01-10 remain separately tracked; current open statuses checked before continuation.
Incomplete-stage behavior is a recovery/coverage gap, not a data-loss finding or strict breach of the explicitly allowed diagnostic-state policy.
retained_positive_evidence: Net partitions retain occurrence qualification before the ERC projection; net anchor transitions and pending electrical/physical correspondence are materially implemented.
Canonical writes recheck under writer leases, and post-append failure exposes CommitOutcomeUncertain.
Nominal physical connectivity reports unavailable geometry as error instead of blanket clean.
Existing terminal, initial transfer, release primitives and prior bounded deliveries retain their demonstrated scope.

findings.title: Enforce authored TrackWidth rules consistently in DRC
findings.observation: Width checking reads only net-class minimum or its fallback; it does not resolve enabled authored TrackWidth rules/scopes/priorities. Routing authoring does resolve scoped authored rules.

minimal_counterexample.source_trace_result: Width check emits no violation although the authored rule requires one.

findings.engineering_consequence: Design authoring/routing and checking can disagree on the governing constraint.

verification.missing_behavioral_proof: Add conflicting net-class/authored-rule fixtures for enabled scopes, priority and disabled rules; compare routing admission with DRC. Narrow finding concerns TrackWidth, not every process-policy path.

findings.proof_limits: Source/control-flow review; no compiled Rust or ordinary application replay.

findings.title: Keep physical errors visible in the DRC check profile

findings.engineering_consequence: A requested physical-rule check can hide its emitted error and present a clean normalized result.

findings.title: Preserve finding correlation across presentation-only renames
findings.observation: ERC IDs use net/component/pin display names; fallback CheckFinding fingerprints hash full ERC payload including those names/messages. DRC fingerprints also hash human messages containing net names.

minimal_counterexample.action: Waive an ERC output conflict, then rename U1 to U7 while preserving source UUIDs and connectivity.
minimal_counterexample.source_trace_result: Name-derived ID/message/payload change, so the fingerprint no longer matches the waiver.

findings.engineering_consequence: Presentation-only changes can reopen accepted findings and create noisy comparison history.

findings.title: Keep hierarchy occurrence identity in ordinary ERC findings
findings.observation: Native connectivity has occurrence-qualified partitions, but NetPinRef projection discards instance_path. Ordinary pin/net ERC uses local names and source pin IDs without qualified net identity; identical repeated-child findings can share a fingerprint.

minimal_counterexample.design: Two instances of one child definition each contain two conflicting outputs on local label SIG.
minimal_counterexample.source_trace_result: Distinct qualified nets produce identical ordinary ERC payload/fingerprints; a fingerprint waiver can match both occurrences.

findings.engineering_consequence: Independent electrical issues cannot be safely navigated or waived separately by instance.

findings.title: Preserve supported pad shapes in Gerber copper projection
findings.observation: PadShape::Oval and RoundRect lower to rectangular PadAperture. Copper export preflight/rotation handles only Rect, then emits rectangle apertures for the lowered shapes.

minimal_counterexample.transcription_result: Both shapes/poses lower to the same unrotated full rectangle.

findings.engineering_consequence: Exported copper can differ from the authored pad geometry without a typed unsupported refusal.

findings.title: Use placement occurrence identity in BOM and PnP comparisons
findings.observation: Inventory rows store component.package (library definition) as package_uuid and omit placement uuid. Comparison falls back to this shared definition when no ComponentInstance binding exists; role-qualified placements can also share a CI key.

minimal_counterexample.design: Board-only R1 and R2 use the same 0402 Package definition.

findings.engineering_consequence: The comparison/drift oracle falsely flags normal repeated footprints; exported rows themselves are retained.

findings.title: Validate the attestation selected as release authority
findings.observation: Release preparation validates candidate.attestations but only copies request.release_authority_attestation into the issued Release. Public engine apply and final snapshot validation do not establish that this selected attestation authorizes that candidate/digest and remains active.

minimal_counterexample.setup: Candidate has valid approval A; another existing attestation B targets an unrelated subject or has valid revocation facts.
minimal_counterexample.action: Select B as release_authority_attestation while retaining A in candidate approvals.
minimal_counterexample.source_trace_result: The examined checks validate A and resolvability/shape of B, not B authorization for this release.

findings.engineering_consequence: A release record can assert unrelated or revoked release authority despite valid separate candidate approvals.

verification.missing_behavioral_proof: Keep valid candidate approval A, vary only selected authority B across unrelated/revoked/wrong-intent/out-of-scope cases; require refusal without authority/head mutation.

findings.title: Bind accepted journal records to their immutable integrity blobs
findings.observation: Integrity verification compares journal tip UUID to head and verifies blob bytes against generation metadata, but never compares the actual accepted journal record payload to its immutable transaction blob. Parent-generation payload coverage is not traversed by this path.

minimal_counterexample.action: After an integrity-backed commit, alter only journal provenance.actor/reason while preserving transaction UUID, operations and revisions.
minimal_counterexample.source_trace_result: Parsing/replay/model revision and inspected integrity checks can still accept Complete despite journal/blob disagreement.

findings.engineering_consequence: History provenance can disagree with immutable authority while integrity inspection reports complete.

findings.title: Define safe continuation after an incomplete uncommitted integrity stage
findings.observation: Staging durably creates a directory before generation.json is written. Recovery parses every stage manifest before checking journal membership; missing/partial uncommitted manifest can make integrity unavailable and prevent further canonical writes.

minimal_counterexample.interruption: After stage directory/blob creation, before complete generation.json and before journal append.
minimal_counterexample.source_trace_result: Intact earlier head/journal/design can be placed in read-only diagnostic state by the abandoned stage.

findings.engineering_consequence: An uncommitted staging artifact can strand ordinary authoring; no safe continuation route was identified in the inspected implementation.

findings.proof_limits: Recoverability/usability gap, not demonstrated data loss or necessarily a requirement breach: REV-I01 explicitly permits read-only diagnostic recovery.
